readMeFirst: The tracked rows in r2-build-rows.json were measured on 2026-08-11, before compiler/eval/spike existed. The gate was wired into build-analyze.mjs on 2026-09-12 and the rows were NOT re-measured that day, so until this record the sentence 'these rows were taken with the instrument shown to be reading' was not true of them -- it was true of the code, and the rows predated it. This file is that re-measurement. The rows themselves are untouched: what is recorded here is whether the same corpus, measured again with the gate in front of it, holds the same MULTISET of rows (byte equality is not expected -- rows are pushed in pool completion order).
question: does the corpus reproduce under the spike/recovery gate, and would the gate have refused a blind instrument?

gate.nonDiscriminating: the two -O0 configurations, one per vendor: at -O0 both spikes are registered to read the same word

negativeControls.name: vendor-absent
negativeControls.how: a gcc-13 first on PATH that exits 1 for every invocation
negativeControls.reason: not installed on this host: gcc-13

negativeControls.name: never-optimises
negativeControls.how: a gcc-13 wrapper that rewrites every -O flag to -O0 and execs the real gcc-13, so the compiler still compiles and still answers, and the answer is the wrong one
negativeControls.whyThisOneMatters: the absent-vendor control only shows the probe works. This one is an instrument that runs, compiles, and reads the wrong word -- the failure the corpus cannot see in its own rows, because a wipe that survived and a wipe the instrument failed to see are the same row.

provenance.comparison: recomputed -- test/regate.test.mjs recomputes the sha256 of data/r2-build-rows.json and its row count and holds this record to them
provenance.gate: recomputed from this run's manifest, which build-analyze.mjs writes beside the lab rows
provenance.regateSha256: lab-run -- the lab file is not tracked, so nothing here can recompute it. It is recorded so a later re-run can say whether it got the same bytes on the same machine
provenance.negativeControls: lab-run -- typed from the two run logs. Nothing recomputes them; the reproduction command is in README.md
